capabilities: render briefs from path-based templates matched by ordered regex rules
extract unchecked tasks from the current note
substitute template variables with file metadata, frontmatter, content, selection, and date
preview the rendered brief in a modal
copy the brief to the clipboard via a command
extras: The plugin makes no API calls or network requests; installation is from the GitHub repo via BRAT or manual file copy rather than from the community plugin catalog.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to assemble a structured, template-based prompt from a note's content, metadata, and open tasks for handing to an AI agent.

relations.evidence: Paste the brief into Codex (or another AI code agent).

requires.name: Codex or another AI code agent

summary: Prompt renderer that builds an AI agent brief from the current note using regex-matched path templates and copies it to the clipboard.
